key_insight: Optimizing curved rectangular vortex generators increased the Colburn factor by 53.1%, or improved area and volume goodness factors by 14.4% and 26.5%, respectively, under separate optimization objectives.
engineering_relevance: Tailored vortex-generator geometry can improve water-to-air finned-tube heat exchanger performance while accounting for the pressure-drop penalty.
method: Developed and validated a conjugate numerical model of a representative heat exchanger section.
Used central composite experimental design and polynomial regression to model four geometry parameters: attack angle, curvature angle, axial position and height.
Applied a genetic algorithm to optimize heat transfer alone and heat-transfer–friction objectives.
evidence_signal: Optimized configurations were evaluated against a plain-fin reference; the reported gains correspond to different objectives and geometry configurations.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify validation accuracy or operating-range robustness, so performance should be verified under intended operating conditions.
paper_title: Optimization of curved vortex generator geometry for enhanced thermal performance in water-to-air finned-tube heat exchanger
